Privacy

Saved in your browser by default

Stored locally, encrypted

Sites, notes and settings are saved in this browser. They are not uploaded to Covelet.

Source code

No extension usage tracking

Sync, daily wallpapers, web searches and manual site lookups use the internet. Privacy checkup explains what each permission is for.

This website uses Cloudflare Web Analytics for visit statistics. Privacy policy

Sync

Sync with your storage (Beta)

Connect your own storage to sync sites, notes and settings across devices. Content is encrypted and sent directly to your storage, without passing through a Covelet server.

Use your own storage

Supports WebDAV services such as Nutstore and Nextcloud.

You choose when versions conflict

If versions conflict, compare the local and remote versions, then choose which one to keep.

R2, OSS, GitHub and GitLab are also available as Beta options.

Backup

Keep a separate backup.

Export your data to a file outside the browser.

Export a data backup

Back up sites, folders, notes and settings. Backup files are not encrypted and include hidden content. Keep them somewhere safe.

Bring your bookmarks

Import a bookmark HTML file exported by your browser. Preview it before importing.
